description.zh:
返回信息的语言类型：

- zh：中文
- en：英文
description.en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

*   zh: Chinese
*   en: English

description.zh: 查询时间。单位：天。比如传入30，说明查询30天内的治理规则情况。
description.en: The query time. Unit: days. For example, if you set this parameter to 30, the governance rules within the last 30 days are queried.

descriptions.zh: 通过GetOverview接口查询服务治理概览信息。
descriptions.en: You can call this operation to query overview information about service governance.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun mse get-overview --period 1 --biz-region cn-hangzhou --accept-language zh --region cn-hangzhou
